recoveryReviews.title: A passenger with opinions
recoveryReviews.existingBody: The remora moved from my shell to my underside. I banked. It stayed. I banked the other way. It adjusted. I have become a place somebody else knows how to live in.
recoveryReviews.reason: No attached remora visible. No prose revision proposed and no binding changed.

recoveryReviews.title: A matching turn
recoveryReviews.existingBody: He rose beside me and turned when I turned. I slowed to make sure he meant it. He slowed too. We spent a while going almost nowhere together, which suited my swimming perfectly.
recoveryReviews.reason: Every frame shows one dragon. Cannot recover a mutual-turn passage from a single-body sequence. No prose revision proposed and no binding changed.
